source_name: BQK — ?lang= language-variant mechanism (sq default, ?lang=en, ?lang=sr) across all pages and PDFs
why_relevant: Structural finding rather than a document: the entire BQK site (including uploaded PDFs, e.g. '...pdf?lang=sr') is addressable in three languages via a query parameter, and Serbian path slugs differ from Albanian ones (o-cbk vs rreth-bqk, finansijska-stabilnost vs stabiliteti-financiar). Any collector must enumerate both slug families or it will silently miss sr-only renderings.

source_name: BQK — Edukimi Financiar FAQ (bqk-kos.org/edu) as a plain-language pointer to licensing/regulatory procedure
why_relevant: States operational procedure in plain Albanian (which department to contact, mandatory informative meeting before licence application, contact details), which helps map internal BQK actors — Departamenti i Licencimit dhe Standardizimit, Departamenti për Mbikëqyrjen Bankare — for the actor map.

source_name: CBK list of licensed/registered financial institutions (bank-perimeter reference)
why_relevant: Not a bank site, but the authoritative dated roster that defines which private banks exist to be monitored in this cell. Needed to keep the crawl perimeter correct as entities enter, convert (Ziraat branch to SHA) or are absorbed (Turkiye Is Bankasi branch into Banka Ekonomike). Dated file path gives a versioned membership timeline.

entity_name: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës
source_name: ARBK — Agjencia e Regjistrimit të Bizneseve në Kosovë (Kosovo Business Registration Agency)
why_relevant: Corporate registry giving legal identity, business number, ownership and status for every licensed financial institution and its agents. Essential for resolving CBK register names to legal entities and for spotting agents/subsidiaries of PSPs that never appear in the CBK list.

source_name: old.kuvendikosoves.org — legacy Assembly document archive
why_relevant: Legacy Assembly site retaining documents from earlier legislatures (pre-redesign). Needed for reconstructing the legislative history of older banking statutes (04/L-093, 04/L-155, 03/L-209) whose bill files are not on the current register — i.e., for building the historical baseline of how long Kosovo banking bills take from first reading to gazette.

source_name: Kosovo Banking Association — Partners / Important Links page
why_relevant: Association link hubs typically enumerate regulators, donor programmes and training partners (ATTF/House of Training, member banks). Ideal snowball seed for expanding the actor map of this cell.

source_name: Kosovo Banking Association (Shoqata e Bankave te Kosoves) — Compliance and AML professional committees
why_relevant: The association's committee pages name the sitting Heads of Compliance and Heads of AML at the member banks (e.g. ProCredit and NLB chairs/vice-chairs). That is a ready-made actor map for the compliance function across the whole cell, and the committees are the forum where CBK draft regulations are collectively commented on — a pointer into the consultation channel.

source_name: Shoqata e Bankave të Kosovës / Kosovo Banking Association — Anëtarët (members page)
why_relevant: Industry-side mirror of the licensed bank population, with member profiles and links to each bank's own site. Useful as an independent cross-check on the CBK register and as the entry point to the downstream publishers (individual banks) that this pointer cell is meant to enumerate; its komunikatat feed also carries sector positions on new regulation.

source_name: ARKEP e-applications / authorisation portal
why_relevant: Authorisation application portal; reveals which entities are authorised to provide electronic communications services — useful when a payment/mobile-money player needs telecom authorisation.

source_name: AmCham Kosovo legacy archive site
why_relevant: Preserved older AmCham Kosovo content — historical position papers and advocacy statements that may have been dropped from the current site during migration.

source_name: Byroja Kosovare e Sigurimit (BKS) — Kosovo Insurance Bureau
why_relevant: Statutory body (Law No. 04/L-018 on compulsory motor liability insurance) constituted by the licensed insurers; its member and correspondent lists mirror the CBK insurance register and its site carries sector-level compliance notices. Pointer into the insurance half of the regulated population.

source_name: CEE Legal Matters – Kosovo section and Legal Briefings
why_relevant: Aggregates law-firm-authored briefings on Kosovo, including an explicit 'Kosovo: New Banking Law Comes into Force with Further Reforms Ahead' briefing and 'The Banking and Finance Legal Framework and the Way Ahead'. Best single pointer for discovering which Kosovo/regional firms are actually writing on banking, and for annual market-overview interviews naming the legislative pipeline.

source_name: CEFTA Transparency Trade Portal — Kosovo (XK) section
why_relevant: Aggregator that consolidates Kosovo import procedures, required documents and the legal bases behind them, with links back to Kosovo Customs instruments. Useful as an English-language index into customs rules governing importation of payments hardware, and to catch procedural changes without reading the customs site directly.

source_name: Chambers and Partners – General Business Law, Kosovo
why_relevant: Second independent directory of Kosovo firms; Chambers also hosts Practice Guides whose Kosovo chapters are firm-written regulatory overviews (a compact, dated summary of the banking/AML framework).

source_name: EU Publications Office — European Forum of Official Gazettes: Republic of Kosovo entry
why_relevant: Independent European description of Kosovo's official gazette: which publisher, what is authentic, whether the electronic version has legal force. Useful for judging evidentiary weight of a GZK text and for confirming the canonical gazette endpoint from a non-Kosovo source.

source_name: IFLR1000 – Kosovo firm profiles (financial and corporate)
why_relevant: IFLR1000 ranks specifically on banking/finance and capital markets, so its Kosovo entries isolate exactly the firms whose alerts matter to this workstream, and its deal lists reveal which firms sit closest to bank clients.

source_name: ITR World Tax – Deloitte Kosovo and peer tax-firm profiles
why_relevant: Maps the Kosovo tax-advisory population (Deloitte Kosova, and peers), which is the community that publishes fiscalization and tax-procedure deadline alerts. Useful to complete the Big Four / next-tier actor map.

source_name: Kosinfo — aggregator of Kosovo Serbian-language media
why_relevant: Multi-source aggregator ('više izvora jedna stranica') pulling feeds from Radio Goraždevac, Radio KIM, Gračanica online and other Kosovo Serb outlets — the cheapest single entry point to enumerate and monitor the whole Serbian-language Kosovo media layer, including small outlets not otherwise indexed.

source_name: Legal 500 – Kosovo rankings and country profiles
why_relevant: Authoritative enumeration of the Kosovo law-firm population, including Deloitte Legal shpk and RPHS Law, with practice-area breakdowns. Use it to build and refresh the actor map of firms that could publish banking/payments alerts, and to find their canonical websites.

source_name: Lexology – Kosovo financial-services law firm articles
why_relevant: Syndication platform where regional firms post Kosovo alerts; a concrete example surfaced covering Draft Law No. 08/L-295 on Crypto-Assets. Useful because it timestamps firm commentary on DRAFT laws — i.e. the consultation stage, before adoption.

source_name: Medija centar (Čaglavica) — Kosovo Serb press-release hub
why_relevant: Republishes institutional statements and announcements aimed at the Kosovo Serb community, including CBK currency announcements; functions as a low-cost aggregation point for Serbian-language institutional communications and as a directory of Kosovo Serb media and NGOs.

source_name: OEK — Enterprise Europe Network local contact point profile
why_relevant: EU-side profile confirming OEK's institutional role and contact points; useful as a stable pointer/identity anchor for the chamber and as a route into EU-funded business-support programming that often carries regulatory-compliance briefings.

source_name: Payments/fintech event calendars (The Paypers, paytech.events, FintechNews CH)
why_relevant: Aggregated conference calendars are efficient pointers for discovering regional events where Kosovo regulators and banks appear; from a calendar entry one snowballs to the agenda and speaker list, which is where the substance sits.

source_name: SEE Legal – Kosovo member page
why_relevant: Alliance of leading South-East European firms; its Kosovo page identifies which regional firm covers Kosovo and links to the member's own publications, a cheap way to keep the actor map of professional interpreters current.

source_name: US Library of Congress — Guide to Law Online: Kosovo (legal guides)
why_relevant: Curated pointer list of Kosovo legal-research entry points, including gazette, assembly and translation sources. Classic snowball node that surfaces aggregators no topical query would reach, and is maintained by law librarians rather than a vendor.
